name: Create Note
description: Creates a note on a contact's record in Intercom. The note is automatically attributed to the currently authenticated admin — no Admin ID prop is required. Use **Search Contacts** to find the contact's ID before calling this action. Example: set **User** to `63a07ddf05a32042dffac965` and **Body** to `Followed up via email on 2024-01-15` to log a note on that contact. Returns the new note object including `id`, `body`, and `author`. [See the documentation](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/api.intercom.io/notes/createnote)
